request.system:
An earlier incident on another project may be relevant to a new issue.
Write one plain sentence (at most 30 words) saying why it is relevant and what happened last time, using only the facts given. No speculation.
Return JSON {"explanation": "..."}.
request.user:
New issue (Drumgarve, 2025-02-07): Energisation forecast delayed. Energisation forecast moves from Nov 2025 to Mar 2026, a slip of approximately 16 weeks.
Earlier incident (Netherwood, 2025-01-20): Incomplete commissioning records. Commissioning records are partial, with some test sheets missing. Outcome recorded: Commissioning records are partial, with some test sheets missing.

response.explanation: The earlier incident at Netherwood had incomplete commissioning records, which may affect the reliability of the current Energisation forecast delay at Drumgarve.
